items.q: Why does Armin say Pi beats fatter harnesses?
items.a: **Bash-first.** Models already know computers. Pipelines keep context lean. Codex 'discover files' is just **`rg`**. Christmas takeoff was **make-it-yours** while Claude Code piled tools (and has since walked some back).

items.q: What is today's coding-agent UI, in his analogy?
items.a: **DOS, not Windows.** He cannot imagine living in this TUI in four years. Factories will hide agents; domain users need a real surface. Home Assistant should **show the house**, not only chat. Banks will not vibe-code: you cannot blame a machine.

items.q: What was wrong with the cloud Codex session he debugged?
items.a: **Postgres never ran.** Tests were mocked; the user did not know. His Mac is faster; Tailscale+SSH is ugly UX vs orbs, but it is a machine he controls. Earendil still has **no robot-Pi factory**.

items.q: How does he score open source — and the weights?
items.a: Only question: **still there and open in 10–15 years.** PHP 1.0 was horrifying; Laravel exists because people stayed. Being **in the weights** is the new SEO ('ask your AI'). Sessions are not getting cheaper.
